tagline: Sine kick drum with pitch sweep, noise click and drive
description: A kick drum synthesizer: a sine wave whose pitch drops from above the base pitch, a 5 ms noise click, tanh drive and a fixed low-pass. Any MIDI note triggers the same kick, with velocity setting the level. The sound is generated digitally; nothing in the code emulates analog circuitry.

features.name: Pitch and Pitch Envelope
features.description: Base pitch 20-200 Hz (default 55 Hz); Pitch Env 0-4 starts the note up to five times higher and Pitch Decay (1-200 ms) sets how fast it falls.

features.name: Decay
features.description: Exponential amplitude decay from 10 ms to 2 s.

features.name: Click
features.description: Mixes in a white-noise burst that fades over about 5 ms, for the beater attack.

features.name: Drive
features.description: Gain of 1-10 into a tanh soft clipper, for a rounder or more distorted kick.

features.name: Tone
features.description: Lowers the sine body by up to half relative to the click; it is a balance control, not a filter.
